name: aves-node
description: WebRTC signaling server library for Node.js

scripts.build: npm run build:cjs && npm run build:esm && npm run build:types
scripts.build:cjs: tsc --module commonjs --outDir dist && cp dist/index.js dist/index.cjs || true
scripts.build:esm: tsc --module esnext --outDir dist/esm && cp dist/esm/index.js dist/index.mjs
